هَيْبَةٌ and ↓ مَهَابَةٌ : see 1. ―
-b2- [As substs., Reverence, veneration, respect, honour, dread, or awe; fear; cautious fear, or caution.] ―
-b3- Also, great, reverend, or venerable, dignity; a quality inspiring reverence or veneration or respect or honour; venerableness; awfulness; a quality inspiring dread or awe. (MF.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
